clusters.reason: The PR updates is_usable_as_basic_json_key_type to allow types convertible to std::string_view as keys, enabling custom string-viewable types to be used in operator[].
Fixes compilation failures when passing classes with conversion to std::string_view into operator[], which is the main goal of issue #3912 and this PR.
The test fails to compile on the new version due to an internal comparator type mismatch error when using a const json object with a custom string_view key.
Directly tests the new type trait check std::is_convertible<KeyType, std::string_view>::value added in the PR, which evaluates to true for convertible types.
Enables successful map lookups using keys that convert to std::string_view instead of failing or picking an unintended conversion.
Breaks usage of ordered_json with transparent comparators when using keys that convert to std::string_view, leading to a substitution failure inside ordered_map.
Validates that multiple distinct custom keys supporting std::string_view conversion are now correctly recognized and usable in operator[].
